features.title: Docker运行时和环境隔离
mustPreserve: non-root + read-only root + writable data volume
environment secrets never persisted
no desktop autostart or startup model warmup

features.title: 官方QQ通道和字符串ID
mustPreserve: OpenID and message IDs remain strings
allowlist before body storage
media realpath boundary and no bypass fallback

features.title: 局域网鉴权和诊断
mustPreserve: explicit Host and same-origin guard
token required on LAN
chosen console passwords accept 8-256 cookie-safe characters; default generated token remains random and long; rotation invalidates old credentials without modifying robot data
QQ source IP and local Host allowlists are distinct

features.title: 扫码授权
mustPreserve: QR authorization requires explicit save confirmation
no credentials in status/logs
cancel and stale callbacks cannot apply

features.title: 多机器人隔离切换
mustPreserve: shared-models separated from per-robot data
restart on switch and stale-page 409
migration preserves originals and rejects unsafe paths

features.title: 群@识别和提示词
mustPreserve: officialAtMe survives stripped content
no false self mention for other people
ingress diagnostics do not claim a reply was sent
bounded ingress metadata journal; no bodies, sender IDs or retroactive delivery claims; app-level blocked sender is not marked forwarded

features.title: 可写扩展安装
mustPreserve: install under current profile extensions, not /app
validate ZIP paths/size and preserve bundled modules
safe ESM compatibility links

features.title: ComfyUI Turbo技能
mustPreserve: text/edit/result workflows with exact Turbo sigmas
same-chat references only
idempotent jobs and no blind resubmission

features.title: Steam史低技能
mustPreserve: native HTTP instead of curl.exe
Steam storeLow not all-store historical low
source failure is not a zero-deal success

features.title: 引用图片和可见回复
mustPreserve: quoted media persisted separately and scoped to chat
refMsgIdx is not a sendable message ID
initial and post-query reminders independently bounded to one each, at most two within existing round budget; never publish reasoning

post-query nudge requires completed matching read-only query result after the previous reminder; web search/fetch or current-message lookup only; no nudge for sent/send attempts/finish/passive or unknown side-effecting tools

features.title: 并发回复绑定
mustPreserve: freeze run context and route at enqueue time
explicit target for multi-user trigger batches
display # normalized only for exact same-chat IDs before queue/dedupe; no fuzzy match

off mode never injects mention tags in group plain text; opt-in per-bot Markdown sends first-bubble tag only in markdown.content with explicit msg_type=2; pinned member, not group ID; matching prefix normalization, conflicts fail; OneBot unchanged
expired/conflicting route fails instead of borrowing newer target
only definitive same-group 4xx permission/unsupported-command rejection permits one clean plain fallback; no resend on timeout/network/5xx/expiry; no client-rendering claims from SDK fixtures
honor persisted off or legacy mode for desktop compatibility; turning Markdown off preserves pinned routing and explicit quotes; no auto Markdown enablement or claim of native plain-text rendering
distinguish current plain-text tag suppression from protocol capability; historical API success is not client-rendering evidence; do not infer all text mentions require Markdown

bounded per-client in-memory text send diagnostics whitelist SDK serialized metadata only; no bodies, identifiers, URLs, credentials or error text; async isolation, no retry/mutation and no client-rendering claims

legacy mode keeps historical SDK helpers and mention guidance; after confirmed raw-ID recurrence, suppress manual atUserId prefix and normalize matching model prefixes before split/history; atUserId still selects/validates frozen route; preserve msg_id, explicit quote, conflict/expiry guards and no Markdown injection; do not equate clean text with native mention rendering

features.title: 删除机器人和favicon
mustPreserve: typed AppID soft deletion preserves data
active deletion transitions to setup, no auto-switch
icons served across all HTML entrances

features.title: 多模型管理
mustPreserve: fetch/test/save/select with no QQ send
keep previous manual model and advanced settings
exact-endpoint credentials, no redirect or global-key leak

features.title: 维护与提交检查
mustPreserve: Git history rooted in verified upstream commit
no runtime data or credentials in Git index
no publishing until explicit user approval

features.title: 看板不可用状态说明
mustPreserve: unavailable panel shows reason without fetching details or enabling providers
HTTP errors preserve error/reason before generic status
escape panel state and ignore stale detail responses

features.title: 干净源码快照与GHCR发布
mustPreserve: publish only audited public history, never private integration ancestry
native amd64 and arm64 tests before publishing a multi-platform image
release compose preserves authentication and data isolation
third-party licensing is separate; no runtime data or personal avatar originals in images

features.title: 严格模型端点工具Schema兼容
mustPreserve: normalize legacy empty or missing root tool schemas at registration and serialization without mutating definitions
reject explicit invalid root types/properties; preserve nested constraints and optional parameters, never force strict mode
basic connection probe is text-only, no skill execution, QQ messages or configuration changes

features.title: 按机器人隔离的群备注与接收诊断
mustPreserve: console aliases persist per robot; keep original OpenID for routing/allowlists and do not rename QQ groups or change model prompts

aliases use authenticated same-origin profile-context routes, escaped display and immediate refresh; empty alias restores fallback; DOM dialog supports embedded browsers and rejects cross-instance submit after await
ingress journal is bounded and metadata-only, scoped to current robot/group; no replay, policy relaxation or QQ test sends

features.title: ChatGPT2API 生图编辑与搜索技能
mustPreserve: disabled by default; no existing bot/model/skill configuration changes, no startup generation/search or live QQ tests
exact model IDs, scoped last-good model catalogs, manual IDs persist; changing service address clears old key unless a new key is supplied
persist before async task submission and queued QQ send; unknown outcomes never blindly regenerate or resend; same-chat references and per-profile jobs
fixed /v1/search engine is not advertised as model-switchable; optional model only summarizes results; whitelist answer and citations, no account fields or raw errors
generic authenticated profile-context model directory UI; no paid probes; preserve known query reminder bounds and exclude image/unknown side-effect tools

features.title: 聚合搜索修复与可选ChatGPT来源
mustPreserve: lazy capability dispatch, default HTML engine name mapping and web_fetch permission; no setup search or implicit retry
optional GPT source uses active configured search.chatgpt2api provider and existing per-profile credentials; no auto enablement, credential copies or config migration
only/parallel/empty-HTML fallback; at most one GPT request per aggregate; no extra summary call or claimed search-model switching
bounded HTTP(S) sources, per-engine unique votes, partial failure vs empty results, deadlines and stop cancellation; uncited GPT answer stays separate from source rankings
search-first image calibration only returns prompts and respects rewrite/budget; no knowledge ingestion or QQ sends; known read-only reply reminder remains bounded
root and nested packaged copies stay identical; preserve installed external modules and existing configurations

features.title: 官方 Git 主上游与独立扩展维护
mustPreserve: official commit is an ancestor, Linux is historical reference only; no unrelated-history merge
official trigger batching/mention identity/prompt anchors/thinking and logger improvements coexist with local reply guards
existing thinking adapter owns parameters when active; no double reasoning usage; no config rewrites
extension versions/catalog maintained separately; installed modules/config untouched by source migration
no production restart, real QQ sends or publication as a side effect of source migration
extension masked settings round-trip by stable account identity and same endpoint; no cross-endpoint key inheritance
explicit image search/send enablement is preserved during official core integration
application and lockfile root versions follow official upstream.version; packaging default matches; extension and immutable Docker release versions remain independent

features.title: 全部现有扩展兼容修复与分层验证
mustPreserve: lazy capability dispatch; await providers and report failure
OpenID exact strings; frozen requester; per-session/per-person isolation
profile paths; atomic writes; close old resources without clearing newer activation
public-only DNS-pinned bounded fetch for user URLs
no auto-enabling modules/model extraction; source-only external updates after complete backup
73 bundled plus 5 installed modules; structural/mock tests are not live API/GPU/QQ certification
